description: This file defines a clientset for interacting with Kubernetes metrics API groups, including functions for creating new client instances with various configurations, and interfaces for accessing specific metrics versions.

classes.name: Interface
classes.description: Interface provides methods to access different versions of metrics APIs and discovery.

classes.name: Clientset
classes.description: Clientset contains clients for different API groups, including discovery and metrics v1alpha1/v1beta1.

methods.name: NewForConfig
methods.description: Creates a new Clientset from the given rest.Config.

methods.name: NewForConfigAndClient
methods.description: Creates a new Clientset from the given rest.Config and HTTP client.

methods.name: NewForConfigOrDie
methods.description: Creates a new Clientset from the given rest.Config, panics on error.

methods.name: New
methods.description: Creates a new Clientset from the given RESTClient.
